name: Material Group Inc.
summary: Material Group Inc. provides PR consulting and digital marketing services in Japan. The company operates through three segments: PR Consulting Business, Digital Marketing Business, and PR Platform Business segments. The PR Consulting Business segment offers various PR methods, including television PR, event promotion, and campaigns using social networking service, supporting clients in brand growth, and marketing communication. The Digital Marketing Business segment provides digital advertising operation support, creative production services, and web customer service tools, including the sale of Flipdesk. The PR Support Platform segment offers Cloud Press Room connecting with media and utilizing freelancers for public relations activities. Material Group Inc. was incorporated in 2014 and is headquartered in Minato, Japan.
